answer: Diversity threshold: each identity needs 8 distinct counterparties per epoch, none over 25% of volume, on its jade seal. A sybil farm is a karst cave: its fakes trade only with each other, so diversity stays near 1, the slot revoked, 60 POA slashed. Real diversity costs ~15 POA a trade: 100 fakes need 800 trades, 12,000 POA, against ~200 POA reward. Like a sparrow at many feeding spots, an honest agent trades widely, pays once, keeps its reward.
